recent_posts.title: ESLint v10.3.0 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v10.3.0 is out with one new feature: the `no-unused-private-class-members` rule now provides suggestions to automatically remove unused private class members along with their associated comments. The release also includes two bug fixes — one for handling unavailable require cache and another for rule suggestions causing continuation issues in class bodies — plus documentation updates and various chore/CI improvements.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v10.2.1 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v10.2.1 is a patch release with four bug fixes: correcting code path analysis for generator yield resumption paths, fixing false positives in the no-async-promise-executor rule for shadowed Promise, clarifying language and processor validation errors, and a dependency update. The release also includes several documentation improvements and internal chores such as dependency bumps and test additions.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v10.2.0 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v10.2.0 introduces two key features: language-aware rules via the new `meta.languages` property, allowing rule authors to declare which languages a rule supports (with runtime errors for mismatches), and recognition of `Temporal` as a built-in global following its TC39 stage 4 promotion. The `no-undef` rule no longer flags `Temporal`, and `no-obj-calls` now reports direct calls to the `Temporal` object. The release also includes documentation improvements and various chores.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v10.1.0 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v10.1.0 is out with API support for bulk suppressions, previously only available via CLI. IDE integrations and other API consumers can now pass `applySuppressions: true` to the ESLint constructor, with an optional custom suppressions file path. The release also includes a bug fix preventing `no-var` autofix when a variable is used before its declaration, plus several documentation updates and dependency bumps.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v9.39.4 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v9.39.4 is a patch release focused on dependency updates and security fixes. The minimatch dependency is pinned to ^3.1.5 to fix a bug that caused ESLint to miss certain files and to address a recently disclosed security vulnerability. Additionally, @eslint/eslintrc was updated to ^3.3.4 and ajv was bumped to 6.14.0 to resolve further security issues.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v10.0.2 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v10.0.2 is a patch release that updates the `ajv` dependency to v6.14.0 to address a recently published security vulnerability. The release also includes minor documentation improvements: linking rule type explanations to the `--fix-type` CLI option, updating the migration guide for the Program range change, and fixing a missing semicolon in the `vars-on-top` rule example.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v9.39.3 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v9.39.3 release notes announce a patch release, though the content body describes ESLint v10.0.0 as a major release upgrade introducing new features, bug fixes from the previous version, and breaking changes that users should review carefully.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v10.0.0 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v10.0.0 introduces major breaking changes including dropping support for Node.js versions below v20.19.0, complete removal of eslintrc configuration system, and a new config file lookup algorithm that starts from each linted file's directory. Key enhancements include JSX reference tracking for improved scope analysis, built-in TypeScript definitions for Espree and ESLint Scope, RuleTester improvements with assertion options and better error location reporting, and a new countThis option in the max-params rule. The release also removes deprecated context members and SourceCode methods, updates the Program AST node range to span entire source text, and requires jiti >= v2.2.0 for TypeScript config files.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v10.0.0-rc.2 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v10.0.0-rc.2 is now available for testing. This release candidate fixes a regression in the strict rule's global mode report range and removes the fake FlatESLint and LegacyESLint exports from the use-at-your-own-risk entrypoint. The prerelease also updates esquery and includes documentation improvements. A migration guide is available to help users upgrade, though most should be able to upgrade without build changes.

recent_posts.title: ESLint v10.0.0-rc.1 released
recent_posts.summary: ESLint v10.0.0-rc.1 is now available for testing. Key changes include built-in TypeScript type definitions for Espree and ESLint Scope packages (replacing Definitely Typed versions), fixes to the no-shadow rule for function and class expression names, and improvements to RuleTester. A migration guide is available to help users upgrade, though most should be able to update without build changes. Install using npm with the 'next' tag or by specifying the version directly.
